method: Official human gene names checked in NCBI Gene records, where supplied by HGNC. Definitions paraphrase the NCBI RefSeq summaries. NCBI Datasets supplied the BTK summary. No variant-level or patient-level interpretation was performed.

entries.label: tumor protein p53
entries.definition: Human gene encoding p53, a tumour-suppressor protein involved in cellular stress responses, cell-cycle control and DNA repair.
entries.source_label: NCBI Gene 7157: TP53 (human); HGNC:11998 approved name; RefSeq summary, December 2016
entries.note: The molecular field identifies this gene. Field presence alone does not establish that testing was performed, that a variant was detected, its pathogenicity, gene or protein expression, or a positive result. Interpret with the source field definition, assay and recorded result. Verified NCBI record updated 15 September 2026.
